title: Preview fixture without images
excerpt: Synthetic no-image template used to preview empty image slots. This is not a published article.
seoTitle: Preview fixture without images (not for publication)
seoDescription: Labeled no-image preview fixture for blog layout review. Not a published article.
intro: PREVIEW-FIXTURE-NO-IMAGE-NOT-FOR-PUBLICATION. This template has no hero and no inline images. Empty image fields must disappear in production layouts.

body.text: [Paragraph] When no hero or inline photo is supplied, the page should not reserve an empty figure, broken URL, or stock image.
[Paragraph] Add a hero object and image blocks only after you have owned or licensed photos with GPS metadata stripped.
